icons.name: server
icons.heading: Server
icons.description: The server handles a request: its activity lights flash in turn. Light: the top unit's light flares and settles, and the bottom unit's light answers a beat later. Strong: both lights flash twice, top then bottom, the second flash bigger. The lights never go out (in Solid they are windows that must stay open), and the rack units never move.

icons.name: processor
icons.heading: Processor
icons.description: The processor runs a clock cycle. Light: the core gathers, then fires; a pulse ring spreads from the core to the package edge and fades, and as it arrives the pins on all four sides kick outward and settle. Strong: two clock beats, tick then a bigger tock, each with its own ring and pin kick. The package never moves.

icons.name: memory-chip
icons.heading: Memory chip
icons.description: The RAM module seats in its slot. Light: the module drives down until its contacts meet the slot and stops dead; the slot takes the hit, dips and settles while the module holds seated a beat, then it springs back up and settles. Strong: a short lift first, a harder drive that buries the contacts in the slot, a deeper slot dip with a rebound, then the release. The module stays rigid.

icons.name: ethernet
icons.heading: Ethernet
icons.description: The plug clicks home in its port. The drawing is the seated plug. Light: it eases back, drives up and stops dead on its seat; two click ticks flick out from the shoulders where it meets the port, and it rebounds once and settles. Strong: a deeper pull back, a harder drive, a bigger click, then a second smaller re-seat. The plug, contacts and cable move as one rigid piece.

icons.name: firewall
icons.heading: Firewall
icons.description: Traffic is blocked. Light: the arrow drives into the wall and stops dead; an impact burst flicks off the wall's face above and below it, and the arrow is knocked back, overshoots and settles. Strong: the arrow winds back first and strikes harder, the bigger burst flies further, and the wall shudders once and holds.

icons.name: usb-drive
icons.heading: USB drive
icons.description: The drive clicks home in its port. The drawing is the plugged-in drive, connector to the left. Light: it eases back out, drives in and stops dead on its seat; two click ticks flick off the body's front corners where it meets the port, and it rebounds once and settles. Strong: a longer pull out, a harder drive, a bigger click, then a second smaller re-seat. The drive moves as one rigid piece.
